entries.partTitle: Capstone Ingress: Global Anycast Routing, Edge WAF Defense & Unified Gateways

left.title: Unprotected Direct Ingress
items: Exposes backend compute directly to internet.
Lacks anycast routing and edge WAF filtering.
High international packet transit latency.

right.title: Master Ingress Edge
items: Over six hundred edge locations filter DDoS.
CloudFront and WAF block threats at line rate.
Unified API Gateways isolate private subnets.

steps.annotation: Direct public ingress exposes backend microservices to DDoS attacks.
CloudFront and WAF inspect global packets at edge locations worldwide.
Edge tier permits authorized requests and blocks malicious attacks.
Private link and anycast routing deliver secure low latency ingress.

entries.partTitle: Capstone Storage: Sub-10ms Polyglot Tier - Valkey, DynamoDB & Aurora Global

left.title: Monolithic Database Tier
items: Forces all access patterns into single engine.
Lock contention degrades flash sale checkouts.
High cross-region failover data loss risk.

right.title: Polyglot Data Tier
items: Valkey cache serves hot reads in one millisecond.
DynamoDB single table commits orders atomically.
Aurora maintains strict financial ledgers with zero RPO.

steps.annotation: Monolithic relational databases suffer severe lock contention at scale.
Polyglot persistence allocates workloads to specialized data engines.
Orchestrator commits orders in DynamoDB Aurora and caches in Valkey.
Multi-tier storage achieves sub ten millisecond composite user latency.

entries.partTitle: Capstone Orchestration: Asynchronous Choreography & Distributed Saga Workflows

left.title: Tightly Coupled Calls
items: Synchronous REST chains cause cascading timeouts.
Lacks automated compensating rollback logic.
Poison pills block downstream processing queues.

right.title: Choreographed Saga Tier
items: EventBridge and SNS fan-out decouple services.
SQS FIFO queues absorb traffic surges safely.
Step Functions sagas coordinate automatic rollbacks.

steps.annotation: Synchronous service coupling causes cascading failures under heavy load.
Asynchronous event choreography decouples publishers from consumers.
Engine coordinates multi-step checkout saga with full verification.
Step Functions sagas execute compensating rollbacks upon step failure.

entries.partTitle: Capstone Lakehouse: S3 Apache Iceberg, Streaming Athena Analytics & FinOps Governance

left.title: Legacy Data Warehouse
items: Uncompressed row scans inflate cloud storage costs.
Lacks ACID transactions on raw object storage.
Manual schema migrations cause analytics downtime.

right.title: Modern S3 Lakehouse
items: Apache Iceberg provides ACID transactions on S3.
Columnar Parquet prunes scan volume by ninety percent.
Automated lifecycle tiering cuts storage expenses.

steps.annotation: Legacy row based warehouses incur exorbitant analytical scan costs.
Apache Iceberg brings ACID transactions and partitioning to object storage.
Projector streams order events to Parquet partitions with scan pruning.
Serverless Athena SQL delivers real time business intelligence at scale.

entries.partTitle: Grand Master Accreditation: 60-Day Curriculum Graduation & Architect Simulator

left.title: Uncertified Engineer
items: Partial understanding of cloud native design patterns.
Struggles with multi-region active-active failover.
Lacks comprehensive hands-on accreditation token.

right.title: Master Cloud Architect
items: All sixty instructional days conquered 100 percent.
Sub-10ms latency and four-nines availability verified.
Awarded official master accreditation token.

steps.annotation: Fragmented cloud knowledge leads to fragile and costly architectures.
Master cloud architects design resilient and cost optimized platforms.
Simulator confirms sub ten millisecond latency and high availability.
Curriculum graduation awards master cloud architect accreditation.
